verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents a single index that serves BM25 full-text, dense, and sparse-vector search, with ranking chosen via score_by, and a hybrid search guide that 'combines a keyword signal with a semantic signal so a single query benefits from both.' However, the documented mechanisms are either a text-match filter applied to a dense search or fusing separate searches with reciprocal rank fusion, so true single-query fusion ranking is not clearly shown. A community user also notes the combined keyword+vector search. Missing for 10: evidence that dense and BM25/sparse are fused in one query server-side rather than via separate searches, details on fusion weighting or configuration, and hands-on corroboration of hybrid ranking quality.
